card.name: Numbers in jobs and economic reports
card.fires_on: Digits, commas and nearby words inside a large count that is being added, gained or lost, such as jobs added or area added, in news-style economic text.

modes.label: Inside big numbers
modes.description: Commas and digits within a figure like 115,000 after a verb such as added.
modes.example: the labor force only added 115<<,>>000 jobs, down 3

modes.label: Words after an added count
modes.description: Linking words right after a count of things added or gained.
modes.example: only 3.7 million jobs<< have>> been added back in.

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens are mostly unrelated Chinese and mixed-language pieces, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up while a news story gives a large number of jobs or other things that were added.
